name: llvm-project
description: The LLVM Project is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies.
one_liner: The compiler technology used to build the tools that turn programming code into running software — deep developer infrastructure, invisible to end users.
buyer: No direct buyer — this is foundational infrastructure used by compiler engineers and chipmakers, not something a business buyer purchases directly.
business_use_cases: A chip company builds a custom compiler backend for its new hardware on top of LLVM.
A programming-language startup builds its language's compiler using LLVM instead of writing one from scratch.
A consulting firm offers specialized compiler-engineering contracting to hardware companies.

money_ideas.idea: Specialized compiler-engineering consulting for chip or programming-language startups.

steal_this: No realistic weekend business here — this is multi-year specialist infrastructure work, not something you ship in a weekend.
